images.after: Step 3: Match each idea to a format
images.title: What changes in every format
images.alt: Three things that change when a blog idea becomes a social post or email: the hook comes first, each piece carries one idea, and link handling differs.
images.caption: Whatever the platform, rework these three before you post.

items.title: The hook
items.text: On a feed, the first line has to be the point, not the context.

items.title: The length
items.text: One idea per piece. Summarizing the whole article is a second blog post.

items.title: The link
items.text: Check whether a caption link is clickable or has to live in your profile.

images.title: One post, three pieces
images.alt: Grid showing how a post on picking a blog name becomes a short video, a carousel and an email, and which piece needs the link to finish.
images.caption: Each piece opens on the idea itself, and none tries to cover the whole post.
